issue.input_source: ECMWF operational IFS Open Data 0.25-degree step-0 and 0-6 hour fields for 2026-10-26 and 2026-10-27; experimental IFS-initialized subseasonal model
issue.scientific_status: Limited 11-member experimental IFS initialization, run retrospectively outside the operational pipeline. Anomalies use an ERA5 2011–2025 calendar-day climatology rather than lead-matched model reforecasts, so they include systematic model bias. Data cover 6–39°N, 66–99°E; extremes and regional probabilities are withheld.

initial_condition_source.label: IFS operational initialization
initial_condition_source.description: Operational ECMWF IFS fields aggregated into the model's two daily input states. Ocean skin temperature is used as the disclosed SST proxy. Experimental.

climatology_alignment.operation_order: subtract the ERA5 2011–2025 mean for each exact valid calendar day from every member's daily field, then aggregate seven days and average members
climatology_alignment.message: Observed-reanalysis baseline, not a model climatology; anomalies include systematic model-versus-ERA5 bias.

issue.anomaly_baseline_note: Anomaly is the forecast minus the ERA5 reanalysis average for the same calendar days (rainfall and temperature: 2011–2025; 850 hPa wind: 2011–2022). It is not a model climatology, so it also contains the model's systematic bias.

wind850_climatology_alignment.source: WeatherBench2 ERA5 1.5-degree conservative, 6-hourly (Google Cloud public dataset)
wind850_climatology_alignment.operation_order: average four 00/06/12/18 UTC samples per valid day over each seven-day week for every year, then equally average the yearly U/V and yearly vector speeds

observation_verification.message: Verification is withheld until every required observation day in a valid week is available.

grid.value_order: latitude-major row order; latitude is north-to-south

rainfall_anomaly.label: Rainfall anomaly
rainfall_anomaly.description: Weekly-mean forecast minus the ERA5 calendar-day climatology
rainfall_anomaly.baseline: ERA5 reanalysis, 2011–2025 calendar-day climatology (includes model bias)

temperature_anomaly.label: Temperature anomaly
temperature_anomaly.description: Weekly-mean forecast minus the ERA5 calendar-day climatology
temperature_anomaly.baseline: ERA5 reanalysis, 2011–2025 calendar-day climatology (includes model bias)

wind850_mean.label: Weekly mean 850 hPa wind
wind850_mean.description: Shading is the speed of the weekly ensemble-mean wind vector; arrows are the weekly ensemble-mean U/V components

wind850_anomaly.label: 850 hPa wind anomaly
wind850_anomaly.description: Shading is the weekly ensemble-mean vector speed minus the ERA5 mean of yearly vector speeds; arrows are the U/V anomaly from the ERA5 mean
wind850_anomaly.baseline: ERA5 reanalysis, 2011–2022 calendar-week climatology (includes model bias)
